# A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop](conjugate/A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. Attraction, threat, authority, desire and remembered injury give a formed appearance force in the next encounter. A [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|local arbitration regime]] selects which answers can count and weights the image through which a person or world is received. Image supplies the appearance, valuation gives it significance, and possession changes its office: what the image represents must now answer to the image.

The image-maker can be possessed by the criteria through which the image is possessed. A self-image, enemy-image, beloved-image or institutional image becomes non-negotiable; contradictory experience then arrives as a defect of the person or world that fails to resemble it. This closure belongs to the relation, not to a particular visual style or the intensity of feeling alone.

## #1

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|Symbolon Dynamics]], an archetype-as-such exceeds any particular appearance. An archetypal image gives one such appearance; a complex organises affect and expectation around it; a symbol can transform the levels of world and interpreter available through it. The transformed interpreter alters what later images can disclose. Valuation returns through a changed recipient who meets the next image differently.

Frank’s protected encounter with [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors|Van Eenwyk]], pp.69–73, follows the known→unknown→known movement through changed conscious categories. Taylor’s agentic question asks whether an image changes attention and relation in that way. A deliberately produced picture or assigned mythological name can leave those conditions unchanged. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image and valuation]] become consequential through how the recipient’s altered organisation changes a later encounter.

## #2

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|Source and reflection]] have an asymmetric order. Bimba is the Original order in which manifestation and reflection arise; pratibimba is a determinate reflection through which that order is encountered. Reflection can arrive first in knowledge while the Original has priority in being. A produced reference can nevertheless serve as genuine local Bimba for downstream readings within a declared Context Frame, while remaining pratibimba relative to its wider sources. Its local authority derives from that particular relation; it cannot become the ontological author of its producing source.

In the stained-glass relation, light, coloured pane and cast image do different work. The formed account of their relation remains within that mediation even when it names the Original. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order|Bohm’s implication and explication]] ask how a determinate appearance retains the order from which it unfolds. In the holographic comparison, local regions retain interference relations from which illumination reconstructs an image, rather than distributing miniature complete copies of the picture. Fractal recurrence repeats a generating relation across scale; it has a different producing operation from holographic reconstruction. Neither comparison establishes historical identity with the Bimba vocabulary. Each retains the transformation by which its appearance is produced.

## #3

Living symbol and idol can be visibly identical. Their difference appears when an encounter resists the image. A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|living symbolic relation]] lets that resistance revise interpretation and valuation. Under possession, the image fixes in advance what the source may disclose: the witness must be ignorant, unfaithful, corrupt or unreal because the account cannot be wrong. A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|protected account]] insulates this judgment from the source which could correct it. The counterfeit `1=0` names source-occupation, not a valid arithmetic identity.

The Job comparison proceeds through three distinct layers. The biblical sequence includes council and wager, loss and affliction, the wife’s response, friends’ initial solidarity and later explanatory closure, Job’s protest, Wisdom, Elihu, whirlwind, rebuke and intercession. The friends try to revise Job in order to preserve their moral account; his witness exposes that account’s failure. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11|Jung’s later Yahweh/Sophia/incarnation interpretation]] gives a second psychological reading; Taylor’s protected psychic and technical accounts supply a third comparison. Sophia belongs to Jung’s interpretation, rather than becoming a character in the biblical telling or a single key replacing its sequence.

In [Apollo’s appropriation after withdrawal](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal), opposed desire and refusal lead through pursuit and transformation into a public emblem whose power survives the failed encounter. Ovid retains both the laurel’s recoil and the ending’s seeming assent. Symbolic appropriation can persist after the living source withdraws. An [answerable account](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#symbol-answers-to-source) retains that refusal as consequential, rather than making the emblem the last word of the encounter.

## #4

An operational profile makes this office-confusion technically legible. A score or model selects access and response; those decisions change the represented person’s available circumstances; the resulting behaviour returns as further evidence for the profile. A mistaken record can be corrected under an adequate criterion. Possession begins when the person’s answer exposes a faulty category, measure or mandate but revision is confined to records so that the governing condition can never be questioned. The representation’s causal efficacy then protects its claim to truth. This constructed mechanism develops [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief|Agentworld’s consequential models and agentic mirrors]] through a jurisdictional return: the affected person can correct the attributed content, contest its measure or withdraw the entrusted standing, and a later representing act must inherit what that answer warrants.

Taylor’s deepfake comparison follows a further break: a sign can fabricate its source relation and the possibility of fabrication can then make an authentic record dismissible as another counterfeit. The second effect attacks the possibility of trusting a real counterpart. A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|fabricated slash]] claims the body–utterance or event–record relation from which its credibility would arise. Provenance participates in a real encounter: persons, records and institutions can answer or withhold the relation the convincing image asks them to carry. Particular prevalence and causal size remain empirical questions.

## #5→0


A profile can help produce the conduct later offered as its confirmation. Through Baudrillard’s account/source comparison, causal efficacy leaves fidelity to the person or encounter to be tested: the profile can act upon that person’s world while remaining false. Possession begins when contrary testimony cannot reach the categories governing the profile. This constructed mechanism keeps a particular causal question distinct from Baudrillard’s stronger cultural diagnosis of reference; the represented person’s answer must be able to change the record, warranted measure or entrusted use, and the next representation must inherit that consequence.

In [Māyā’s frame](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation), another person’s role can be supplied before they answer. Valuation turns that prepared image into a source-claim when every reply confirms its assigned place. A mistaken portrayal can receive correction; an exclusion built into the framing criterion requires that criterion to become answerable. In a nested relay a produced result can genuinely govern a later act while retaining its provenance. Counterfeit source begins where that producing relation is erased. The psychological and technical cases keep their distinct evidential tasks.

In [the Hypostasis telling](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/hypostasis-archons-norea-sophia/WHOLE.md#27-eleleth--rescue--revelation-of-the-root), the rulers model a human from a reflected image yet cannot originate the life they seek to possess. Norea refuses their asserted descent; Eleleth answers her inquiry by disclosing their genesis and her root. Sabaoth’s changed allegiance and the promised future liberation remain distinct from her immediate rescue. This image–authority relation opens Taylor’s proposed Hybris, Māyā, evaluator and psychological comparisons, while the tractate’s rescue and soteriology retain their sequence and difference from his account of manifestation.

In [Fanon’s language–gaze–mask field](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/francophone-anticolonial/fanon-language-gaze-mask-recognition/WHOLE.md#fanon-language), the colonial relation gives metropolitan speech both capacity and prestige. Acquiring its form can enable participation while carrying an imposed criterion into self-evaluation. The [mask](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/francophone-anticolonial/fanon-language-gaze-mask-recognition/WHOLE.md#fanon-mask) enables an act under conditions that can also judge the speaker through an alienating image. Taylor’s proposed adaptive-interface and idol/image readings follow this double consequence while retaining Antillean/metropolitan history and embodied racialisation. A generic avatar or Jungian persona would omit the relation which makes Fanon’s comparison consequential.

In [Indra’s jewel-net](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence), a shining image of interdependence can itself become an object of attachment. The source’s qualification of its optical simile must remain effective even when a more complete-looking picture attracts attention. Valuation stays answerable where the source can change what the image asks the reader to see.

In [Apollo, Dionysus and Daphne](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/apollo-dionysus-daphne/WHOLE.md#apollo-diaphaneity-return), Apollo’s communicable form receives Dionysian participation while Daphne retains a response neither power owns. Appropriation can continue through the emblem even after a grasp fails. A renewed image remains alterable by the other’s answer; remembering that it once opened does not complete its present return.

In [the funhouse mirror](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-funhouse-narcissus), an image can capture the capacity which would judge its distortion. Fascination can attach to the flattering or frightening figure while living comparison weakens. Initiated return restores comparison to the person whose exteriorised judgments helped make the glass: the image discloses a limit and permits an answer capable of changing its next reflection.

In [Mother, Assumption and chiasm](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return), the rabbit/angel ambiguity leaves a particular identification unresolved. The Assumption chiasm asks whether recognition retains the body it represents. An achieved spiritual account stays answerable where the embodied condition can correct the image and its valuation; transcendence cannot earn fidelity by erasing what it receives.

In [the planetary jigsaw image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge), a picture can predetermine what particular lives and places must mean. Recovering its gauge and production lets those particulars resist that assignment. The image discloses Earth through its situated achievement while permitting encountered sources to change the authority claimed through it.

The nurturing or engulfing image, paternal law and heroic self-image organise different fields of valuation. In [Neumann’s sequence](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond), transformation depends on whether a changed encounter can alter the image’s governing interpretation. The [uroboric circle-costume](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return) becomes an idol when visible completion forbids the relation which could change its authority. Release and renewed assimilation return the apparent whole to the powers and differentiated life through which it can continue.

A [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|travelling account]] remains answerable to its counterpart. The represented source can correct the image, its valuation or the criteria under which it acts, through the office the particular failure exposes. A fitting criterion can remain after correction with reasons. Strong images continue to orient a life; their force becomes responsibility for keeping this route available and carrying the received answer into later representation.

The [[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|Other]] exceeds its model; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|deference]] lets an encountered difference reach its actual source, measure or commission. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|Individuation]] changes the relation to an image rather than securing one immune to change. The result of representation comes back into the world it has affected and becomes a condition another representing act can inherit or revise.

In [Job’s return](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return), the friends first sit with the suffering witness, then make his suffering legible through a moral account, then treat his contrary testimony as further fault. Their eventual dependence on his intercession returns valuation to the person their explanation had disqualified. Encounter changes the image’s authority; its ability to organise judgment alone cannot establish fidelity.

In [the Village’s administered image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability), publicity supplies the candidate’s answers and the election in *Free for All* delivers an office whose freedom-command has no governing force. Contrary speech is processed within the account rather than changing its authority. Production of consent and expectation is a real effect whose answerability to the represented people remains a separate relation.

[Avatar, image, mask and idol](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) mediate through distinct offices: avatar makes presence effective, image gathers attention and value, mask enables participation, and idol closes the represented life’s route of reply. One form can enact several offices. Its success becomes possession when the person can no longer change what the image is permitted to mean and do; continued fidelity can require receiving withdrawal as an answer.

In [counterfeit provenance](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md#avatar-counterfeit-provenance), a fabricated recording claims a body–utterance or event–recording relation through which its statement asks to be trusted. The availability of fabrication can then be invoked against a genuine witness. These closures affect different source relations. Their prevalence, magnitude and particular media cases require evidence from actual encounters, beyond the authored construction.

[Comparison through proportion and relation](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD-homology-and-analogy.md#e5-whole-returns) follows an image’s content, gathered valuation and resulting capacity or capture through the whole encounter. Similar appearances can arise through different organisations; similar effects can have separate histories. Avatar, image, mask and idol retain their operative differences while source, receiver and later consequence disclose what this image has actually changed.
